checklist.text: Medir el tiempo hasta el primer cuadro y hasta el menú
Mover a carga diferida lo que no haga falta

description: Medir qué se carga antes del primer cuadro: autoloads, preloads grandes, recursos del menú. Bajar lo que no haga falta en el arranque.
notes: Linux measured (8a6d7311, warm cache): windowed Vulkan ~2.25 s to the first title frame, ~1.3 s of which is renderer start-up; autoloads ~200 ms (DialogueManager 78 ms, from the addon, can't be deferred); title 19 ms. Deferred: intro and pipeline warm-up (-39 ms); Feel no longer synthesizes (15.12). Still pending: Windows and a cold cache (Windows session, with measure_shaders.ps1 or by timing the build).
